event.title: PPHM Open
event.description:
Pin Point Heritage Museum is open from Thursday – Saturday from 9am to 4pm.

Located in the former A.S. Varn & Son Oyster and Crab Factory, guests can discover the Gullah/Geechee culture and unique lifeways, from daily life to religion, language, and food directly from residents who grew up in the small, close-knit community.

event.title: OFJ: Daily Programming and Cannon Firings
event.description: Join us for family-friendly educational programming focusing on the lives of soldiers once stationed at Fort Jackson and its 18th-century predecessor, Mud Fort! CHS Historical Interpreters will lead interactive programs on weaponry, wartime communications, military medicine, and more, while dressed as soldiers from different units present on-site over the 250 years of its history.

event.title: Special Sunday Storytime
event.description:
All aboard for a fun morning of books, crafts, and trains!

Join us at Savannah Children’s Museum on Sunday, November 15, 10:30-11:30AM for a special author visit and book signing with Kelly Young-Silverman, author of Hot Boiled Peanuts, and Rosalind and Maggie Bunn, authors of All Aboard, Georgia! and The Naughty List.

Kids can enjoy a peanut-themed craft inspired by Hot Boiled Peanuts, a train-themed craft inspired by All Aboard, Georgia!, and coloring fun while meeting the authors and celebrating their books.

Books will be available for purchase, or bring your own copies from home to have signed.

Included with admission. Free for Coastal Heritage Society members. Become a member: chsgeorgia.org/membership

event.description:
Save the date for Savannah Santa Train on Saturday, Dec. 12th, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.

Tickets will go on sale soon!

This beloved holiday event hosted by Coastal Heritage Society takes place at Georgia State Railroad Museum and Savannah Children’s Museum.

New this year: CHS Members are invited to a special Donuts with Santa hour from 9 to 10 a.m. Become a member today to join this early-access experience: chsgeorgia.org/membership

Festive activities include train and handcar rides; photos with Santa; holiday crafts; Hanukkah, Christmas, and Kwanzaa activities; live entertainment; and so much more!

Santa Train is sponsored by:

For sponsorship opportunities, contact development@chsgeorgia.org

event.title: SHM: Guided Programming
event.description: Savannah History Museum Guided Programs are held on Fridays and Saturdays at 10:30am, 12:00pm, and 2:00pm. Join us for family-friendly educational programming focusing on various topics of Savannah’s rich history. Interactive programming may be inside Savannah History Museum or continue outside on the adjacent Battlefield Memorial Park. Programs are included with your regular admission!

event.title: OFJ: Daily Programming and Cannon Firings
event.description: Join us for family-friendly educational programming focusing on the lives of soldiers once stationed at Fort Jackson and its 18th-century predecessor, Mud Fort! CHS Historical Interpreters will lead interactive programs on weaponry, wartime communications, military medicine, and more, while dressed as soldiers from different units present on-site over the 250 years of its history.

event.description:
